lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.17 - A Look and write

details: Look and write recaps new vocabulary from the unit and evaluates students’ ability to write a word correctly using visuals.
Look for recall of vocabulary and ability to spell words correctly.
“Let’s try and raise money for charity. We could have a concert! Or have a sports tournament? What could you all do?”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.18 - Speaking Play a board game Ask and answer

details: Ask and answer creates semi-controlled practice for students in the form of a board game. They practise questions and answers using ‘What does he/she play after school?’ or ‘Does he/ she play…’ in pairs for both vocabulary sets.
Look for confident use of ‘What does he/she play after school? Does he/ she play….’ questions and clear sentence answers.
